description: Query current and historical repository trends from the Trendshift Signal API.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Trendshift Signal API token sent with the Authorization Bearer header. Subscribe and obtain access from the official Signal page: https://trendshift.io/signal

actions.name: get_github_trending_by_date
actions.description: Get Trendshift's captured GitHub Trending list for a specific scrape date.

date.description: A calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

language.description: A repository language filter, or all to include every language.

inputSchema.description: The scrape date and optional language for a captured GitHub Trending list.

anyOf.description: The local scrape date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

trend_date.description: The local scrape date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

anyOf.description: The lowercased list language, or null for all languages.

language.description: The lowercased list language, or null for all languages.

rank.description: GitHub's rank for the repository in the captured list.

full_name.description: The GitHub repository name in owner/repository form.

language.description: The repository's primary language as reported by GitHub.

stars_now.description: The repository's total star count at query time.

forks_now.description: The repository's total fork count at query time.

items.description: A repository in a captured GitHub Trending list.

anyOf.description: The repositories in GitHub's captured rank order.

data.description: The repositories in GitHub's captured rank order.

actions.name: get_trending_daily_by_date

date.description: A calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

language.description: A repository language filter, or all to include every language.

limit.description: The maximum number of repositories to return per page.

cursor.description: The opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

forks_now.description: The repository's total fork count at query time.

stars_gained.description: The stars gained during the ranking period.

forks_gained.description: The forks gained during the ranking period.

score.description: Trendshift's trending score for the period.

items.description: A repository in a Trendshift trending list.

anyOf.description: The ranked repositories, or null when unavailable.

data.description: The ranked repositories, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page, or null at the end.
